decisions.reason: The one-tier pyramid sits squarely in the core seasonal assortment and uses existing workshop skills, so keeping it costs little and it continues to add value to the range.

With the electronic music box line withdrawn in 2019, this platform has lost the product it was built to complement, so its option value is unlikely to be realized and its resources are better redeployed.
The Christmas motif platform was tied to the abandoned electronic music box system and is distant from the core offer, so the uncertainty has resolved against it and holding it no longer pays.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and has steady gift and tourist appeal at minimal holding cost, so it remains a sound part of the established business.
